body_markdown:
When using the Tower Semiconductor logo, be sure to follow the Company’s branding[guidelines](https://towersemi.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/Tower-Semiconductor-Brand-identity-guidlines_External-1.pdf) .


If you would like to use the logo in any other manner, please email[\[email protected\]](https://towersemi.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#264f48404966524951435455434b4f0845494b) . Include in your email how you would like to use the logo and a Tower Semiconductor rep will contact you.
